name: overwatch
description: v0.1.18: review-queue now risk-ranks by normalized severity (High-first) then recency, so a stale high-severity item is never buried/evicted below fresh low-severity noise; --limit yields the top-K riskiest and reports the deferred remainder. Project-global cross-session execution ledger + dedup guard + PDO progress view + fleet-level correlated gate-violation detection. Manages claim registry with heartbeat-based liveness, skip-on-duplicate contract for distributed session coordination, and normalized violation-signature recurrence/escalation across tasks and sessions.
